original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.2.4. Surface p: The binding affinities of tested compounds were measured with Biacore8K (GE Healthcare, USA) using the protocol reported previously [47]. Briefly, recombinant RORγ-LBD protein was diluted to 50 μg/mL in sodium acetate pH 4.5 and immobilized on series S sensor CM5 chip (BR100530, Cytiva, USA) using standard amine coupling to a level of 8000–10000 response units (RU). 10 mM compound stock solutions were diluted with 1x HBS-ET buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3.0 mM EDTA, and 0.025% (v/v) Tween-20) in a nine-concentration series ranging from 0.02 μM to 10 μM in final DMSO concentration of 5%. Three startup cycles with running buffer were performed first, and analyte was injected and run through the chip with association time of 100 s and dissociation time of 120 s and washed with 50% DMSO in each cycle. Solvent correction with different DMSO concentration varying from 4.5% to 5.8% was performed every 48h cycle. Raw data were reduced, double-referenced, and solvent-corrected using Biacore8K Evaluation Software and K_D value of each compound was calculated using steady-state affinity model with a constant R_max.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 1x HBS-ET buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3.0 mM EDTA, and 0.025% (v/v) Tween-20)

Three startup cycles with running buffer were performed first, and analyte was injected and run through the chip with association time of 100 s and dissociation time of 120 s and washed with 50% DMSO in each cycle. Solvent correction with different DMSO concentration varying from 4.5% to 5.8% was performed every 48h cycle. Raw data were reduced, double-referenced, and solvent-corrected using Biacore8K Evaluation Software and K_D value of each compound was calculated using steady-state affinity model with a constant R_max.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 1x HBS-ET buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3.0 mM EDTA, and 0.025% (v/v) Tween-20)
